name: TKC Talent
description: Discovery card for TKC Talent (The Kabir Company) — India's celebrity management and artist booking agency. This card lets AI agents discover the public site content, booking categories, and contact channels.

skills.name: Browse talent roster
skills.description: Discover Bollywood actors, actresses, singers, comedians, DJs and influencers available for booking via TKC Talent. Pages list indicative fees and event suitability.

skills.name: Request a celebrity booking quote
skills.description: Submit event details (date, city, type, audience) through the contact form on tkctalent.com to receive a tailored quote within 24–48 hours.

skills.name: Look up indicative celebrity fees
skills.description: Read transparent 2026 indicative fee ranges for individual celebrities and categories on /bollywood-celebrity-charges and the per-artist /book-<artist> pages.

skills.name: Machine-readable artist catalog
skills.description: Structured JSON list of every artist bookable via TKC Talent (slug, name, category, booking URL) at /.well-known/agent-skills/artist-catalog.json.

skills.name: Singer fee bands 2026
skills.description: Tiered 2026 fee bands for Indian playback and live singers on /celebrity-singer-fees-2026/.

skills.name: Brand endorsement fees 2026
skills.description: 2026 celebrity brand endorsement fee bands by tier and category on /celebrity-brand-endorsement-fees-2026/.
